newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy aviation gasoline, kerosene.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy aviation gasoline, kerosene.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy aviation gasoline and superior kerosene, industry sources said on Thursday.
The tender seeks 1,800 tonnes of aviation gasoline and 18,000 tonnes of superior kerosene.

Offers are to be made on a free-on-board basis for cargoes to be lifted not further than the Mediterranean which must be able to arrive at the Indian east coast port of Budge Budge before January 15, traders said.
The tender closes on December 4 and offers are valid to December 6.
